headline: Spot Bitcoin Funds Shed $487 Million as Bitcoin Slips to 82k and Greed Stays Ahead of the Cycle
narrative: Spot bitcoin funds lost $487 million in the latest print, ether funds lost $161 million, and solana funds lost $4.8 million, while bitcoin trades near 82k after a 2.3% decline. Fear and greed reads 69, greed, while the cycle index sits flat at 56 in complacency, so sentiment has run ahead of both the cash leaving the funds and the cycle score. Funding is calm at 0.0038%, the dollar is firm at 102.57, and volatility is quiet, with the VIX at 15.21 and seven-day realized volatility at 22.28% against 49.13% over thirty days, so the outflow is not being matched by a leverage chase or a volatility bid.
author: jordan
